integrations.seoDescription: See which channels and systems {product} can connect to, what moves between them, and which connections need a custom setup.
integrations.title: Where {product} fits into your current work
integrations.lead: This list separates available connections, custom setup and planned work. A platform logo is never treated as proof that every account can be connected automatically.

ledger.title: System, connection and data flow in one row
ledger.intro: Final access and compatibility are confirmed before setup. Planned items are shown as planned.

flows.calls: Call status and approved call outcomes for {platform}.
flows.callResults: Completed-call results and cases requiring attention are sent to {platform}.
flows.appointments: Available times, confirmations and changes for {platform}.
flows.customerRecords: Only the customer fields approved for the workflow in {platform}.
flows.paymentEvents: Approved payment status and transaction references are exchanged with {platform}.
flows.messages: Incoming messages, approved replies and handoff status in {platform}.
flows.websiteEvents: Approved website changes and publication status for {platform}.
flows.analyticsMetrics: Selected visits, conversions and measured outcomes are read from {platform}.
flows.domainSettings: Only the approved domain and publication settings are changed in {platform}.
flows.forms: Form fields and the resulting business task from {platform}.
flows.taskRecords: Approved tasks, owners, due dates and completion status are exchanged with {platform}.
flows.documents: Selected source files and review status from {platform}.
flows.applicationRelease: Approved build and release information for {platform}.
flows.notifications: Approved notification content and delivery status in {platform}.
flows.sourceReview: Agreed source files, findings and verification status for {platform}.
flows.campaignSignals: Spend, enquiries and measured outcomes linked to {platform}.
flows.contentPublishing: Approved materials, schedule and publication status in {platform}.
flows.fleetCommands: Approved dispatch or depot tasks for {platform}.
flows.routingData: Pickup, destination and route information required for the trip is exchanged with {platform}.
flows.depotSchedule: Approved charging, cleaning and depot schedules are exchanged with {platform}.
flows.telemetry: Selected vehicle status and incident signals from {platform}.

cta.title: Tell us which systems you already use
cta.description: aiNOW checks access, limits and the safest connection path before promising an integration.
cta.label: Check my systems

security.seoDescription: Understand how {product} access, actions, approvals, retention, deletion and human escalation are defined before launch.
security.title: You see what {product} may read and change
security.lead: Before launch, aiNOW writes down the source access, allowed actions, approval boundary, retention rule and human handoff. Uncertain work does not become an invisible automatic decision.

flow.title: Four visible stages
flow.intro: The exact systems and fields are project-specific; the control sequence stays the same.
flow.s1Description: The product receives only the source and fields named in the scope.
flow.s2Description: It performs only the actions written into the operating boundary.
flow.s3Description: Important or uncertain cases wait for a person.
flow.s4Description: The business can see what happened and what needs attention.

controls.title: Six questions answered before launch
controls.intro: These controls are part of the project scope, not decorative security claims.

sourceAccess.title: Source access
sourceAccess.description: {product} receives only approved systems, files and fields.

actions.title: Allowed actions
actions.description: The product cannot silently expand beyond the written workflow.

approval.title: Approval boundary
approval.description: Important changes and uncertain cases wait for the named person.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: The project names what is stored and for how long.

deletion.title: Deletion
deletion.description: Deletion requests have a named channel and confirmation step.

escalation.title: Human escalation
escalation.description: The workflow names who receives a case the product should not decide.

limitations.title: What is not assumed
limitations.item1: aiNOW does not expand access to your data or permission to act without prior written agreement.
limitations.item2: A public landing page does not collect or process your operational business data.
limitations.item3: Exact providers, retention periods and access rights are confirmed in the written project scope.

cta.title: Ask about your actual data flow
cta.description: aiNOW will map the sources, actions and approval points for your specific process.
cta.label: Discuss my data flow
